title: Remittances Reached $685 Billion—More Than Foreign Investment
hook: Workers sent $685 billion home, outweighing foreign investment.
closing: Workers' transfers can support families more than the investment headlines suggest.
question: Have you ever sent money home?

segments.say: Remittances reached $685 billion. Families rely on workers sending money across borders.
India received $120 billion. One country alone captured a huge share of the flow.
Remittances exceeded foreign investment by $270 billion. Workers' paychecks outweighed big-business money.
